title: Artificial Utopia: Simulation and Intelligent Agents for a Democratised Future
reasoning: The paper focuses on proposing a research agenda ('Artificial Utopia') for using computational simulations and AI to study democratic systems. While it includes a discussion of 'practical and ethical questions' regarding the societal impact and distribution of simulation technology, it does not evaluate religion, morals, or ethics as a primary subject of benchmarking or study.
